content.bridge_context: Understanding the natural transition from childhood to adulthood.

units.title: What is Adolescence?
units.explanation: The period of life when the body undergoes changes, leading to reproductive maturity.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify one physical change you've noticed in teenagers. / किशोरों में देखे गए एक शारीरिक परिवर्तन की पहचान करें।

units.title: Hormones
units.explanation: Chemical substances that control changes in our body. Secreted by endocrine glands.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name the master gland. / मास्टर ग्रंथि का नाम बताएं।
